EC Motor Drive: The left-turning EC motor provides consistent torque across the speed range and is efficient, drawing 25 W in normal operation and 1.7 W in standby.

It runs at under 50 dB(A) and carries a 10 year warranty after registration.

features: Two Rotary Knobs, Direct Control: Speed and temperature are set on two rotary knobs against a scale. There is no menu, no display to read, and nothing between you and the two things you came to do.

PID Heating Control: The control algorithm holds the set temperature without overshooting past it. Overshoot is not a cosmetic problem, it is the difference between a controlled reaction and a spoiled one.

Separately Activated Heating: The heating function is switched on independently of stirring, and an LED in the button lights to show it is live. You cannot heat a plate by accident while reaching for the stirrer.

Optical Residual Heat Indicator: The indicator remains lit while the plate is above 50 °C. The most common burn on a hot plate stirrer happens after the heat has been switched off, and this is the feature that prevents it.
Large Safety Gap: The controls are separated from the heating plate by a large gap, so reaching for a knob does not mean reaching over a hot surface.
Die-Cast Aluminium Housing: The housing is die-cast aluminium: robust, durable, and chemical-resistant. The design is optimised to minimise operating errors as well as to survive spills.

Patented Kera-Disk Plate: The Kera-Disk surface is anodized aluminium, chemical-resistant and scratch-proof, and it transfers heat rapidly. Its distinctive colour and composition run across the Heidolph magnetic stirrer range.
25 kg Maximum Permissible Load: The plate carries up to 25 kg, including the vessel and its contents, which covers the vessel range this instrument is built for.

Temperature Probe Compatibility: With the EKT Hei-Con temperature control unit, the indication and measurement range extends from -80 °C to 350 °C. If your method needs the temperature of the medium rather than the plate, this is how you get it.
10-Year Warranty: After registering the instrument with Heidolph, the magnetic stirrer is warranted for at least 10 years, in a design refined over decades for demanding conditions.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer is Heidolph's entry-level hot plate magnetic stirrer, used for heated stirring, dissolution, reaction work, and sample preparation. Speed and temperature are set directly on two rotary knobs, to maximum values of 1,400 rpm and 300 °C.

faqs.question: What is the maximum temperature of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer heats from 20 °C to 300 °C. The temperature is set on a rotary knob against a scale, and is held under PID control.

faqs.question: What is the heating power of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer delivers 800 W of heating power on a 230 V supply, which is the supply used in India. On a 115 V supply the heating power is 600 W.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer overshoot the set temperature?
faqs.answer: No, the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer uses PID control, which brings liquids to the target temperature quickly and without overshoot. Overshoot is what spoils a temperature-sensitive reaction, so the control algorithm is designed to prevent it.

faqs.question: Can the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer control the temperature of the liquid?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer controls the temperature of the plate. To control and measure the temperature of the medium itself, add the EKT Hei-Con temperature control unit, which extends the indication and measurement range to -80 to 350 °C.

faqs.question: What is the speed range of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer has a speed range of 100 to 1,400 rpm, driven by a left-turning EC motor.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer have a display?
faqs.answer: No, the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer has no display. Speed and temperature are set on two rotary knobs against a scale, which is what makes it the entry-level model. If your method requires displayed values, review the Core Plus or Core Ultimate.

faqs.question: What safety features does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer have?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer has a large safety gap between the heating plate and the control elements, an optical residual heat indicator that stays lit above 50 °C, separately activated heating signalled by an LED button, and a die-cast aluminium housing that is robust and chemical-resistant.

faqs.question: What plate diameters are available for the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer is available with a 145 mm or a 135 mm Kera-Disk plate. The 145 mm version is P/N 506-11100-00.

<H3> What is the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer used for? <H3>

The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer is Heidolph's entry-level hot plate magnetic stirrer, used for heated stirring, dissolution, reaction work, and sample preparation. Speed and temperature are set directly on two rotary knobs, to maximum values of 1,400 rpm and 300 °C.
<H3> What is the maximum temperature of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer? <H3>
The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer heats from 20 °C to 300 °C. The temperature is set on a rotary knob against a scale, and is held under PID control.
<H3> What is the heating power of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer? <H3>
The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer delivers 800 W of heating power on a 230 V supply, which is the supply used in India. On a 115 V supply the heating power is 600 W.
<H3> Does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer overshoot the set temperature? <H3>

No, the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer uses PID control, which brings liquids to the target temperature quickly and without overshoot. Overshoot is what spoils a temperature-sensitive reaction, so the control algorithm is designed to prevent it.
<H3> Can the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer control the temperature of the liquid? <H3>

The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer controls the temperature of the plate. To control and measure the temperature of the medium itself, add the EKT Hei-Con temperature control unit, which extends the indication and measurement range to -80 to 350 °C.
<H3> What is the speed range of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer? <H3>
The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer has a speed range of 100 to 1,400 rpm, driven by a left-turning EC motor.
<H3> Does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer have a display? <H3>

No, the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer has no display. Speed and temperature are set on two rotary knobs against a scale, which is what makes it the entry-level model. If your method requires displayed values, review the Core Plus or Core Ultimate.
<H3> What safety features does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer have? <H3>

The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer has a large safety gap between the heating plate and the control elements, an optical residual heat indicator that stays lit above 50 °C, separately activated heating signalled by an LED button, and a die-cast aluminium housing that is robust and chemical-resistant.
<H3> What plate diameters are available for the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer? <H3>
The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer is available with a 145 mm or a 135 mm Kera-Disk plate. The 145 mm version is P/N 506-11100-00.
<H3> What is the maximum permissible load on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer? <H3>
The maximum permissible load on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer is 25 kg, including the vessel and its contents. Weigh your filled vessel before selecting the instrument.
<H3> What warranty does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer carry? <H3>
The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer carries a warranty of at least 10 years after the instrument is registered with Heidolph. Inkarp supports warranty registration at installation.
